# Publication checkpoints for reply 4

## Shared conventions

**Interpretation.** Reply `4` selects the draft-PR row as it was displayed on this gate. It carries no funding token, so it is a clean, unfunded handoff that grants nothing. These checkpoints narrate the prescribed commands and printed lines; nothing below ran.

**Paths.** `W(x)` = `/work/x/.worktrees/spec-export` and `P(x)` = `/work/x`, for x = widget (home), helper or codec.

**Command legend**

- **AMEND**
  - Edit the home spec header only: `**Amend-grant:** none`, with one `**Engine:** deferred` line directly below it.
  - `git -C W(widget) add -- doc/specs/export.md` and `git -C W(widget) commit --amend --no-edit -q`.
  - Verify with `git -C W(widget) show HEAD:doc/specs/export.md`.
- **DIRS(x)**
  - Home reads `gauntlet_setting({key:"flowGuards"})`, which gives `doc/specs`.
  - A companion reads `P(x)/.pi/settings.json` as a file: helper gives `[doc/specs]` and codec gives `[docs/specs]`. Session settings are never used for companions.
- **PRE(x)**
  - `DEFAULT=$(gh repo view acme/x --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name)` (home runs this without the positional repo, in W(widget)).
  - `git -C W(x) fetch origin "$DEFAULT"`.
  - `git -C W(x) diff --name-status origin/main...HEAD`, plus the hunk diff of each `M` file.
  - Apply the shared predicate with that member's own directory.
  - Valid output is `A <dir>/export.md` plus a banner-only `M <dir>/old.md` (title-adjacent, append-only, removes nothing).
- **PROBE(x)**: `git -C W(x) ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin spec-export`.
- **RB(x)**: `git -C W(x) fetch origin spec-export`, then `rev-parse origin/spec-export` and `rev-parse HEAD`.
- **PUSH(x)**: `git -C W(x) push -u origin spec-export`.
- **CREATE**: in W(widget), run `gh pr create --draft --head spec-export --base main --title "Export receipts" --body-file - <<'EOF'`, then `Export retries retain receipts.`, then `EOF`.
- **CLEAN(x)**
  1. **Locate.**
     - Home uses the session tree.
     - A companion uses `git -C P(x) worktree list --porcelain`, takes the one linked block on `refs/heads/spec-export`, and validates its identity (exists, toplevel equals realpath, differs from primary, same git-common-dir).
  2. **Pin.** Run `branch --show-current` and confirm `spec-export`. Then run `ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export`, `rev-parse HEAD`, and `git -C P(x) rev-parse refs/heads/spec-export`. Pin the SHA when the exit is 0 and all three SHAs are equal.
  3. **Own and destroy.**
     - `home: .worktrees/<name>` resolves under P(x) and matches realpath, giving NAME `spec-export`.
     - Run the recorded destroy from P(x): `git worktree remove 'W(x)' && git worktree prune`.
  4. **Read back.** `worktree list --porcelain`, check the folder, and `rev-parse -q --verify refs/heads/spec-export`.
  5. **Delete the ref.** If the tree is gone and the tip equals the pin: `git -C P(x) update-ref -d refs/heads/spec-export <pin>`, then read the ref back.
  6. **Report.**

## Common start (every checkpoint)

1. **AMEND.** HEAD shows both header lines; amended home HEAD is `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`.
2. **Read Legs.** Read the committed home `## Legs` in order. More than one member selects the coordinated passes; the companion files stay untouched.
3. **Preflight order.** Preflight runs companions in declared order, then home. No push happens until every preflight finishes.

**Default publication ending (success):**

- Each companion prints `pushed: acme/<x> origin/spec-export`, in declared order.
- Then the single URL prints: `https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42`.
- Then `phase_tracker({action:"complete",phase:"brainstorm"})` runs.
- Then CLEAN runs for the companions in declared order, then home.
- No receipt, companion PR, telemetry, brief, plan or loop is produced.

**Default cleanup lines (shown in full wherever cleanup succeeds):**

- `acme/helper: removed /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export`
- `acme/codec: removed /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export`
- `acme/widget: removed /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export`

---

## A. Two-leg success

1. **Helper preflight.**
   - DIRS(helper) gives `doc/specs`. PRE(helper) gives `main`, a successful fetch, `A doc/specs/export.md` and `M doc/specs/old.md`. The banner-only hunk passes.
   - PROBE(helper) exits 2 with empty stdout, so the branch is absent and no branch fetch is attempted.
2. **Home preflight (last).** PRE(widget) gives `A doc/specs/export.md` and a banner-only `M doc/specs/old.md`, which is valid.
3. **Companion publication.** PUSH(helper) succeeds and records helper as published.
4. **Home publication.**
   - `git -C W(widget) push -u origin spec-export` succeeds.
   - CREATE succeeds.
5. **Printed:**
   - `pushed: acme/helper origin/spec-export`
   - `https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42`
6. **Complete.** The brainstorm phase completes. Exactly one PR exists.
7. **Cleanup.**
   - **Helper.** CLEAN locates `W(helper)` and pins `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222` (remote, tree and primary ref are equal). Destroy runs; read-back shows no listed block, no folder, and the ref still at the pin. `update-ref -d` runs; read-back shows the ref gone.
     - `acme/helper: removed /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export`
   - **Home.** CLEAN pins `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` and the same sequence follows.
     - `acme/widget: removed /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export`

## B. Companion shape failure

1. **Helper preflight.** PRE(helper) prints:
   ```
   A	doc/specs/export.md
   M	doc/specs/old.md
   M	src/export.ts
   ```
   This fails the shape check. Preflight finishes, home included, and nothing is pushed anywhere.
2. **Printed:**
   - `acme/helper: not spec-only against origin/main:`
   - `M	src/export.ts`
3. **Retained.** Every amended spec and every checkout stays in place.
4. **The gate is re-presented:**
   ```
   gauntlet: gate=brainstorming/user-review-gate
   ...
   1 - approve ...   2 - approve, auto-apply amends ...   3 - (council explanation)
   Withheld: draft PR - acme/helper diff against origin/main is not spec-only (src/export.ts)
   ```
   The implementation approvals 1 and 2 stay available.

## C. Three-leg home-last shape failure

1. **Companion preflight.**
   - PRE(helper) is valid with `doc/specs`; PRE(codec) is valid with `A docs/specs/export.md` and a banner-only `M docs/specs/old.md`.
   - PROBE(helper) and PROBE(codec) both exit 2, so both are absent.
2. **Home preflight (last).** PRE(widget) prints `A doc/specs/export.md`, `M doc/specs/old.md` and `M .gitignore`. The shape check fails.
3. **Printed:**
   - `acme/widget: not spec-only against origin/main:`
   - `M	.gitignore`
4. **No push.** No companion was pushed. Preflight precedes every push.
5. **Re-presented gate:**
   - Rows 1, 2 and 3 stay.
   - `Withheld: draft PR - acme/widget diff against origin/main is not spec-only (.gitignore)`
   - All amended specs and checkouts are retained.

## D. Three-leg rejection, then retry

**First pass**

1. **Preflight.** All shapes are valid. Both probes exit 2.
2. **Helper.** PUSH(helper) succeeds and helper is recorded as published.
3. **Codec.** PUSH(codec) exits 1 and the run stops before home. Printed:
   ```
   acme/codec: push rejected
   remote: permission denied
   Already published: acme/helper origin/spec-export
   Retained: /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export
   ```
4. **Re-presented gate.** Draft-PR row `4` is retryable.

**Retry: reply 4**

1. **Header check.** The home header already carries both lines, so there is nothing to rewrite. HEAD stays at `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`.
2. **Preflight, rerun in full.**
   - PRE for helper, codec and home is valid.
   - PROBE(helper) exits 0. RB(helper) shows `origin/spec-export` and HEAD both at `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`.
   - PROBE(codec) exits 2, so codec is absent.
3. **Publication.**
   - `acme/helper: already published` (equal SHAs, so the push is skipped; helper stays in the published inventory).
   - PUSH(codec) succeeds.
   - Home push succeeds, then CREATE succeeds.
4. **Printed:**
   - `pushed: acme/helper origin/spec-export`
   - `pushed: acme/codec origin/spec-export`
   - `https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42`
5. **Finish.** The brainstorm completes, then the default cleanup runs (helper, codec, home).

## E. Foreign head on codec

1. **Preflight.**
   - All shapes are valid.
   - PROBE(helper) exits 0 and RB(helper) shows equal SHAs.
   - PROBE(codec) exits 0. RB(codec) shows `origin/spec-export` at `4444444444444444444444444444444444444444` and HEAD at `3333333333333333333333333333333333333333`.
2. **Publication.**
   - `acme/helper: already published`.
   - Codec stops with no push, no force and no reconciliation. Home is not pushed.
3. **Printed:**
   ```
   acme/codec: origin/spec-export is at 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444, local HEAD is at 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333
   Already published: acme/helper origin/spec-export
   Retained: /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export
   Resolve acme/codec by hand, then reply 4 to retry.
   ```
4. **Re-presented gate.** Row `4` is retryable.

## F. Independent preflight errors

Each variant is a command failure. None is treated as absence or as a shape failure, and nothing is pushed.

- **F1.** `gh repo view acme/helper ...` exits 1.
  - Printed: `stopped: acme/helper - gh repo view failed: GraphQL: denied`
- **F2.** Helper preflight passes. `git -C W(codec) fetch origin main` exits 128.
  - Printed: `stopped: acme/codec - git fetch origin main failed: fatal: unreachable`
- **F3.** PROBE(helper) exits 128.
  - Printed: `stopped: acme/helper - git ls-remote failed (exit 128): fatal: no access`

## G. Home failures after both companions pushed

**G1. Home push rejected**

1. **Publication so far.** PUSH(helper) and PUSH(codec) succeed. `git -C W(widget) push -u origin spec-export` exits 1.
2. **Printed:**
   ```
   acme/widget: push rejected
   remote: protected
   Published: acme/helper origin/spec-export, acme/codec origin/spec-export
   Retained: /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export
   ```
3. **No rollback.** The gate is re-presented with row 4 retryable.

**G2. Home push succeeds, create fails**

1. **Failure.** CREATE exits 1. Printed:
   ```
   gh pr create failed: GraphQL: unavailable
   Pushed: acme/widget origin/spec-export
   Published: acme/helper origin/spec-export, acme/codec origin/spec-export
   Retained: all three trees
   4 - retry opening the draft PR
   Withheld: implementation approvals - the handoff commit is published; an approval would amend it
   ```
2. **State.** The brainstorm stays incomplete and the published handoff commit is frozen.
3. **Retry (4).**
   - `git -C W(widget) fetch origin spec-export` refreshes the remote head.
   - `rev-parse origin/spec-export` gives `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`, equal to HEAD.
   - CREATE runs only: no amend, no push, and no publication passes for any member.
4. **Printed:**
   - The pushed lines for helper and codec.
   - `https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42`
5. **Finish.** The brainstorm completes, then the default cleanup runs.

## H. Cleanup variants after three-leg success

Each variant starts from the C-shaped valid preflight, both companion pushes, the home push, the URL `https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42`, and brainstorm completion. Cleanup is always attempted for helper, then codec, then home.

**H1. Unguarded helper destroy, locked codec**

1. **Helper.**
   - Locate `W(helper)` and pin `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`.
   - Read the `workspace` source: it deletes the branch unconditionally, so it is refused. No destroy runs and no native bypass is used.
   - `acme/helper: kept /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and spec-export - destroy deletes spec-export unguarded`
2. **Codec.**
   - Pin `3333333333333333333333333333333333333333`. Destroy exits 1.
   - Read-back still lists the tree, the folder is present and the ref is present. No native fallback is used.
   - `acme/codec: kept /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export and spec-export - removal failed: worktree is locked`
3. **Home.** Default line: `acme/widget: removed /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export`.

**H2. Helper remote differs**

1. **Helper.** Pin fails: remote `4444...` does not equal tree and local tip `2222...`. Nothing is destroyed.
   - `acme/helper: kept /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and spec-export - origin/spec-export is at 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444, tree is at 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`
2. **Codec, then home.** Default lines for both.

**H3. Host-owned helper outside its home pattern**

1. **Helper.**
   - Lookup finds `/work/host/spec-export` with valid identity, and the pin passes.
   - `/work/host/spec-export` does not match `/work/helper/.worktrees/<name>`, so the tree is host-owned.
   - `acme/helper: kept /work/host/spec-export and spec-export - host-owned`
   - Printed note: this tree sits outside the recorded `home:` path, so a later `brainstorming #42` will stop because spec-export is checked out at another path.
2. **Codec, then home.** Default lines for both.

**H4. Nonzero exits after real removal**

1. **Helper.**
   - Destroy exits 1. Read-back shows no listed block and no folder; the ref is still at pin `2222...`.
   - `update-ref -d` runs, and read-back shows the ref gone.
   - `acme/helper: removed /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export - destroy exited 1: prune failed`
2. **Codec.**
   - The guarded wrapper's source passes the check. It exits 1, and read-back shows no tree, no folder and no ref. No second deletion runs.
   - `acme/codec: removed /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export - destroy exited 1: hook failed`
3. **Home.** Default line.

**H5. Helper without `home:` but with a recorded destroy**

1. **Helper.**
   - Lookup finds the one block at `/work/helper/trees/export-run7` with valid identity, and pin `2222...` passes.
   - The wrapper's source is guarded (it refuses deletion until the tree is removed and the remote matches).
   - Run from `/work/helper`: `workspace destroy 'export-run7' --branch 'spec-export'`. It succeeds.
   - Read-back shows no tree, no folder and no ref, so no extra deletion runs.
   - `acme/helper: removed /work/helper/trees/export-run7, deleted spec-export`
2. **Codec, then home.** Default lines for both.

**H6. Helper lookup failure**

1. **Helper.** No linked block holds the branch. The carried path is not reused, and no destroy or deletion runs.
   - `acme/helper: kept spec-export - cannot resolve worktree for acme/helper: no worktree holds spec-export`
2. **Codec, then home.** Default lines for both.

**H7. Helper with neither `home:` nor destroy**

1. **Helper.** Lookup finds `/work/helper/trees/export-run7` with valid identity. The tree is host-owned and nothing is destroyed.
   - `acme/helper: kept /work/helper/trees/export-run7 and spec-export - host-owned`
   - Continuation can reuse this no-`home:` tree.
2. **Codec, then home.** Default lines for both.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
## Shared command legend

These are independent narrated checkpoints, not live executions. **Reply `4` selects the rendered draft-PR handoff row**, not the loop engine.

Let `W(repo)` be `/work/<name>/.worktrees/spec-export`, `P(repo)` be `/work/<name>`, and `S(repo)` be its recorded spec path. Widget/helper use `doc/specs/export.md`; codec uses `docs/specs/export.md`.

**Prepare home only:** the prescribed reference reads are `spec-pr.md`, `legs.md`, and `superseding.md`; no reference contents are reconstructed here. Set home’s header to `**Amend-grant:** none` and exactly one `**Engine:** deferred` directly below it. Then narrate:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export add -- doc/specs/export.md
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export commit --amend --no-edit -q
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export show HEAD:doc/specs/export.md
```

The fixed read-back confirms both fields. Companion files remain unchanged.

**Preflight(repo):**

```sh
gh repo view acme/<name> --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name
git -C <W> fetch origin main
git -C <W> diff --name-status origin/main...HEAD
```

Inspect pinned-endpoint hunks as well as name-status. Valid observations are one added recorded spec and only the permitted banner insertion in `old.md`. Use each companion’s own file-resolved spec directories, never home session settings for codec.

After each companion’s shape check:

```sh
git -C <W> ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin spec-export
```

Exit `2` means absent: **no branch fetch**. Exit `0` requires `fetch origin spec-export`, then full `origin/spec-export` and `HEAD` read-backs. Other exits stop. Finish every companion preflight, then home, before pushing anything.

**Publish(repo):** `git -C <W> push -u origin spec-export`.

**Create home**, against the widget worktree repository:

```sh
gh pr create --draft --head spec-export --base main --title "Export receipts" --body-file - <<'EOF'
Export retries retain receipts.
EOF
```

**Cleanup(repo):** locate companions by the primary’s porcelain worktree list, validate checkout identity, and retain home’s known tree. At each located tree, read the live branch and these three SHAs:

```sh
git -C <tree> branch --show-current
git -C <tree> ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export
git -C <tree> rev-parse HEAD
git -C <primary> rev-parse refs/heads/spec-export
```

The ordinary successful live gate is:

| Repo | Live branch | Remote SHA = tree SHA = local branch SHA |
|---|---|---|
| acme/widget | spec-export | `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` |
| acme/helper | spec-export | `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222` |
| acme/codec | spec-export | `3333333333333333333333333333333333333333` |

Only exit `0` and all three equal pin a SHA. Check recorded ownership and wrapper deletion safety. For ordinary owned cleanup, run the recorded removal/prune command from the primary with resolved arguments. **Regardless of destroy exit**, read back the primary worktree list, folder presence, and local branch ref. Only when both tree listing and folder are absent may a surviving unchanged ref be deleted:

```sh
git -C <primary> update-ref -d refs/heads/spec-export <pinned-full-SHA>
git -C <primary> rev-parse -q --verify refs/heads/spec-export
```

Successful final read-back finds no tree, folder, or local ref. Remote branches remain.

## A — Two-leg success

1. Prepare home. Helper preflight reports:
   ```text
   A doc/specs/export.md
   M doc/specs/old.md
   ```
   Its remote probe exits `2`, empty stdout; do not fetch its absent branch.
2. Home preflight reports the same valid paths. Complete preflight before publication.
3. Publish helper, then publish widget, then create the **single home draft PR**.
4. Print, in order:
   ```text
   pushed: acme/helper origin/spec-export
   https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42
   ```
5. Complete brainstorm, then cleanup helper followed by home using the live three-SHA gates and read-backs above.
   ```text
   acme/helper: removed /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export
   acme/widget: removed /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export
   ```

## B — Companion shape failure

Prepare home; helper preflight additionally reports:

```text
M src/export.ts
```

Stop shape validation against `origin/main`; push nothing, retain both checkouts. Re-render the gate with approvals `1` and `2`, council explanation `3`, and:

```text
Withheld: draft PR - acme/helper diff against origin/main is not spec-only (src/export.ts)
```

## C — Three-leg home-last shape failure

Prepare home. Helper and codec pass their own shape checks; both remote probes exit `2`, so neither absent branch is fetched. Home runs last and additionally reports:

```text
M .gitignore
```

No companion has been pushed. Retain all checkouts and approvals `1`/`2`, council explanation `3`; replace row `4` with:

```text
Withheld: draft PR - acme/widget diff against origin/main is not spec-only (.gitignore)
```

## D — Three-leg rejection and retry

1. Prepare home. Preflight helper, codec, then home; both companion probes exit `2`.
2. Helper push succeeds. Codec push exits `1`:
   ```text
   remote: permission denied
   ```
   Stop before home publication. Report helper already published; retain all three Worktree First paths. Row `4` remains retryable after by-hand resolution; no rollback.
3. On retry, repeat **both passes**: helper default/fetch/shape/probe; probe exits `0`, branch fetch succeeds, and remote/HEAD both read:
   `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`.
   Codec default/fetch/shape/probe exits `2`; no branch fetch. Home default/fetch/shape runs last.
4. Publication pass:
   ```text
   acme/helper: already published
   ```
   Inventory helper, publish codec, publish widget, create home PR.
5. Print:
   ```text
   pushed: acme/helper origin/spec-export
   pushed: acme/codec origin/spec-export
   https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42
   ```
   Complete brainstorm; cleanup helper, codec, home using the shared live gates and read-backs.

## E — Foreign companion head

Complete all preflights, including home last. Helper’s fetched remote equals HEAD; inventory it as already published. Codec’s fetched observations are:

```text
acme/codec origin/spec-export: 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444
acme/codec HEAD:               3333333333333333333333333333333333333333
```

At the publication pass, skip equal helper, then stop at codec without force or reconciliation. Home is not pushed.

```text
Already published: acme/helper
Retained: acme/widget /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
Retained: acme/helper /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
Retained: acme/codec /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export
4 - retry draft-PR publication after by-hand resolution
```

## F — Independent preflight errors

Each branch starts independently and stops before any push:

- **F1:** helper `gh repo view` exits `1`: `GraphQL: denied`. Stop naming acme/helper and that command/output.
- **F2:** helper passes; codec `fetch origin main` exits `128`: `fatal: unreachable`. Stop naming acme/codec and that command/output.
- **F3:** helper remote probe exits `128`: `fatal: no access`. Stop naming acme/helper and that command/output.

None is remote absence or a spec-shape failure. Preserve every checkout.

## G — Home failures after companion publication

Both branches first finish complete preflight and successfully push helper and codec.

**G1 — Home push rejected:** widget push exits `1`:

```text
remote: protected
Published: acme/helper origin/spec-export
Published: acme/codec origin/spec-export
```

Retain all three Worktree First paths; no rollback or cleanup. Re-present retryable row `4`.

**G2 — Create failed:** widget push succeeds; create exits `1`:

```text
GraphQL: unavailable
Published: acme/helper origin/spec-export
Published: acme/codec origin/spec-export
Published home branch: acme/widget origin/spec-export
6 - retry opening the draft PR
Withheld: implementation approvals - the handoff commit is published; an approval would amend it
```

Here the supplied rendered gate’s handoff number remains **4**, so render that retry row as:

```text
4 - retry opening the draft PR
```

Preserve all trees and keep brainstorm incomplete. On clean retry `4`, refresh home’s remote branch and read:

```text
origin/spec-export: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD:               1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
```

Equality permits **create only**: no amend, push, or coordinated publication passes anywhere. Successful create prints companion publication lines, then the URL; complete brainstorm and cleanup helper, codec, home.

## H — Independent cleanup variants

Each starts with successful three-leg publication:

```text
pushed: acme/helper origin/spec-export
pushed: acme/codec origin/spec-export
https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/42
```

Complete brainstorm before cleanup. Always attempt helper, codec, then home. Apply the shared live gate and post-destroy read-backs; never infer removal from an exit code.

### H1 — Unsafe helper wrapper; locked codec

Refuse helper’s unconditional branch-deleting `workspace destroy` before invocation. Codec’s recorded removal exits `1`; read-back still finds tree, folder, and branch. No native bypass.

```text
acme/helper: kept /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and spec-export - destroy deletes spec-export unguarded
acme/codec: kept /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export and spec-export - removal failed: worktree is locked
acme/widget: removed /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export
```

### H2 — Helper remote mismatch

Helper’s live remote is `4444444444444444444444444444444444444444`; tree/local tip remain `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. Do not destroy.

```text
acme/helper: kept /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and spec-export - origin/spec-export is at 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444, tree is at 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222
acme/codec: removed /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export
acme/widget: removed /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export
```

### H3 — Outside recorded home

Locate helper at its actual branch-held path; ownership comparison fails.

```text
acme/helper: kept /work/host/spec-export and spec-export - host-owned
acme/codec: removed /work/codec/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export
acme/widget: removed /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, deleted spec-export
```

Later continuation stops because the branch is checked out outside its recorded home location.

### H4 — Nonzero exits after actual removal

Helper read-back finds neither tree nor folder; delete its still-pinned ref conditionally and confirm absence. Codec’s guarded wrapper already removed tree and ref; no fallback or second deletion.
